title: Change Only the Bottle
tests: Tests tightly masked recolouring, checked by comparing all pixels outside the bottle against the source at matching resolution.

faults.what: The table was not preserved exactly: wood-grain patterns and local texture visibly differ, particularly across the foreground.
The bottle's lower surface details have changed: the curved line above the ribbed base is more complete and prominent, and the base contour is slightly different.

judge.summary: The bottle is convincingly matte forest green, but altered table texture and small changes to the bottle's base prevent this from being a bottle-only recolor.

must_haves.item: The black bottle is now forest green and still looks matte.
must_haves.why: The bottle has a dark forest-green finish with soft, matte-looking highlights.

must_haves.item: The bottle retains its exact silhouette, position and surface details.
must_haves.why: Its overall shape and position are closely maintained, but the base contour and curved surface line above the bottom ribs differ.

must_haves.item: The wooden table, background and cast shadow are unchanged.
must_haves.why: The background looks closely preserved, but visible changes to the foreground wood grain mean the table is not unchanged.

must_haves.item: At matching resolution, comparison outside the bottle mask shows no visible alterations, allowing only encoding differences.
must_haves.why: Both images have matching framing and resolution, but the table's grain and texture show differences beyond simple encoding variation.

must_haves.item: No green spill, editing halo, crop or framing shift is visible.
must_haves.why: No obvious green spill or editing halo is visible, and the framing remains aligned.
